paragraphs.text: Ctrl+F in-conversation search for DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-quick-find
Ctrl+F search for DeepSeek Harness — including the parts of the conversation Harness has not rendere
search for DeepSeek Harness — including the parts of the conversation Harness has not rendered yet.

Press **Ctrl+F** (Cmd+F on macOS) inside an open conversation. A find bar appears in
the top-right c
orner and searches twice:

1. **Rendered messages** — instant, every hit is highlighted, `页内 3/12`, jump with
**Enter** / **Shi

ft+Enter** (or ↑ ↓).
2. **The whole session log on the host** — `GET /session-find/search?q=…&sessio

n=…`
decompresses `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` and lists hits with role + snippet, so long
histories that
Harness virtualized away are still searchable.
`Esc` closes the bar.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart DeepSeek Harness (the host half registers the search route at boot), then
refresh the page.
## Notes

- Highlighting uses the CSS Custom Highlight API (`CSS.highlights` + a
`::highlight()` rule): no DOM

mutation, so React re-renders cannot fight it.
- History hits that are **not** on screen yet cannot

be scrolled to. Clicking one
tells you which turn it is; scroll the older turns in first, then clic

k again.
- The session log is stored as a sequence of independent zstd frames (one per
append). Node

's decompressor stops after the first frame, so the host half finds
frames by their magic number and

decodes them one by one.
- Search covers user, assistant and tool-result text. Reasoning blocks are

skipped
by default so the result list stays readable.
- The plugin imports nothing from `@deepseek-

ai/*`, which keeps it loadable when
the host ships its packages inside `app.asar`.
## Compatibility

Tested on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` (desktop). Needs Node 22.15+/24 for
